ai_semiconductor_news.headline: U.S. and China launch New York talks on AI safety, trade and critical minerals
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters reported U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng opened talks in New York ahead of the Trump-Xi summit. AI guardrails, tariffs, agricultural and Boeing purchases, and reliable rare-earth flows were among the subjects; no major breakthrough was verified by the cutoff.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: China's CXMT says fifth-generation DRAM platform has entered mass production
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: CXMT said its fifth-generation memory platform is in mass production and unveiled 24Gb LPDDR5X products. Reuters reported the process uses quadruple patterning with 11.95nm feature spacing and is designed to raise dies per wafer by at least 50% versus the prior generation.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Saudi and Gulf equities weaken after fresh Houthi attacks on Riyadh
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Saudi Arabia's main index ended Sunday 0.3% lower and Qatar fell 1.1% after Houthi missile and drone attacks. Aramco recovered from early losses to close 1.3% higher. The move confirms that weekend geopolitical risk is affecting regional assets before U.S. cash markets reopen.

breaking_news.headline: Bessent-He Lifeng talks begin with AI safety, trade and critical minerals on the agenda
breaking_news.market_impact: The meeting can move advanced-chip policy, rare-earth supply expectations and China revenue assumptions for NVIDIA, AMD and TSMC. Treat any Sunday headlines as policy news, not as a replacement for Friday equity closes.

breaking_news.headline: CXMT starts mass production on a more advanced DRAM platform
breaking_news.market_impact: China's memory localization is accelerating. The near-term read-through is greater competitive pressure for global DRAM suppliers and a deeper domestic supply chain, while AI-memory demand remains structurally strong.

breaking_news.headline: Saudi and Gulf stocks fall after renewed Houthi attacks
breaking_news.market_impact: Friday's WTI settlement at $100.30 predates this Sunday market reaction. Monday oil and Treasury yields remain the first cross-asset check on whether the geopolitical shock is being repriced.

narration_points: 今天沒有新的美股現貨交易日，所有正式收盤仍鎖定9月18日；週日重新開盤的期貨只能當盤中指示，不能覆蓋canonical。
週日最新政策焦點是美中在紐約啟動AI安全、貿易與關鍵礦物談判；先進晶片限制與稀土供應是NVIDIA、AMD與TSMC本週最直接的政策風險。
中國CXMT宣布第五代DRAM平台量產，並推出24Gb LPDDR5X，代表中國記憶體自主化正在加速，全球DRAM競爭再升級。
中東風險仍未解除；沙烏地與海灣股市週日受Houthi攻擊消息拖累。WTI週五100.30美元的結算早於這些週日反應，週一油價與10Y仍是第一個驗證點。
週五SOX仍上漲2.78%，AMD上漲2.70%、NVIDIA上漲1.34%、TSM ADR上漲1.02%，價格結構尚不支持AI硬體需求崩塌。
台指期202610的9月21 session夜盤已完成，收47,405點、下跌23點；night_session_oi仍必須為null，不能拿9月18日總OI 101,893口冒充。
本週美國數據重點是9月23日Flash PMI、9月24日初領失業金與新屋銷售、9月25日耐久財。
本週財報看AutoZone、KB Home、General Mills、Cintas、Paychex、Costco與Darden；其中Costco是最大單一企業催化。
